decision.broader_universe_policy: Keep all 1578 eligible post-exclusion candidates open; after this stability prerequisite, reassess broader cross-symbol exploration before any mechanism-specific economic outer.
decision.economic_boundary: No economic identity, outcome, attempt, promotion or family closure is opened by this proposal.

frozen_screen.multiplicity: Evaluate the twelve ordered pairs with a predeclared Holm-Bonferroni descriptive prerequisite screen.
frozen_screen.observation_law: Use only timestamps where all four broker-native series have rows at t-5m, t, t+5m, t+10m and t+15m; exclude gaps and sessions without rows; no forward fill, synthetic bars, resampling or parameter search.
outputs: stability comparison against the accepted development prerequisite

implementation_constraints: Preserve exact broker symbol identities and account fingerprint.
Use read-only authenticated Pepperstone cTrader/Open API retrieval.
Reject incomplete, duplicated, out-of-interval, synthetic or forward-filled rows.
Stop at the external data gate if the exact capture cannot be returned and accepted.
next_research_state.next_action: Acquire and validate the exact four-symbol disjoint M5 capture, then execute only the frozen lead-lag structural prerequisite.

objective.goal: Evaluate temporal stability of a prospectively frozen cross-market lead-lag directional prerequisite on a disjoint broker-native sample before considering any economic identity.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The accepted four-series M5 capture provides 9455 strict consecutive common pairs and 9208 fixed 15-minute windows, so the lead-lag prerequisite is measurable, but existing development direction counts are descriptive and near-balanced. A minimal disjoint sample can test stability without reopening prior outcomes, while the broader 1578-symbol universe remains open. The accepted 40 representatives are sufficient for the immediate next decision but insufficient for mechanism-wide economic inference; broader exploration remains positive expected information gain after this targeted stability check.
